title: CRT phosphor mask: aperture grille, delta dots and slots
purpose: Generate tileable maps of a CRT screen's phosphor layer: aperture-grille stripes with damper wires, a delta shadow mask of RGB dots or a staggered slot mask, with scanlines and an optional picture, as glowing emissive subpixels. Use for retro monitors, arcade cabinets, terminals and screen overlays.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python crt_phosphor_mask.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: mask
parameters.meaning: 0 aperture grille stripes, 1 delta shadow mask dots, 2 slot mask.

parameters.name: triads_across
parameters.meaning: Red, green and blue triads across the tile.

parameters.name: scan_strength
parameters.meaning: How dark the gaps between scanlines are.

parameters.name: picture
parameters.meaning: Blend from a flat white screen (0) to a colourful procedural picture (1).

parameters.name: spot
parameters.meaning: Size of each phosphor spot within its cell, with soft falloff.

parameters.name: glow
parameters.meaning: Brightness of the lit phosphors in the emissive map.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo and the light in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Aperture grille: continuous RGB stripes with soft scanlines.

presets.name: shadow_mask_delta
presets.description: Delta shadow mask: round RGB dots in triangles, fine pitch.

presets.name: slot_mask
presets.description: Slot mask: short staggered RGB slots, as on many consumer sets.

presets.name: arcade_low_res
presets.description: Low-resolution arcade monitor: coarse slots, deep scanlines, a picture.

limits: A close-up pattern, not a display simulation: phosphor spots have Gaussian profiles, the beam adds a fixed scanline profile, and there is no convergence error, bloom, persistence, curvature or glass reflection. The picture is a smooth procedural image sampled per subpixel. Counts are whole numbers across the tile so the mask repeats; fine pitches alias when a stripe or dot is narrower than about three pixels. Phosphor primaries are approximate sRGB colours.
technique_references: Aperture grille stripes with damper wire shadows
Delta shadow mask on a triangular lattice with a three-colouring of rows
Slot mask with alternate triads offset by half a slot
Gaussian phosphor spot and scanline beam profiles
Whole-number triad and row counts for exact tiling
